title: Best Practices for an Effective RSS Feed
content:
Optimize Your RSS Feed

A well-structured RSS feed improves the visibility of your content. Here are some tips:

  1. Catchy titles: Use clear and descriptive titles
  2. Complete descriptions: Provide enough context
  3. Quality images: Thumbnails attract attention
  4. Regular updates: Publish fresh content
A good RSS feed is the key to a loyal audience.
author: Marie Dupont

title: Guide: Integrating Your RSS Feed into Your Website
content:
Here's how to easily integrate your RSS feed into your website:

1. Add the link tag to your head

<link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" title="My Feed" href="/rss/feed.xml" />

2. Display the RSS icon

Use a clickable RSS icon to redirect to your feed.

3. Share the URL

Share your feed URL with your readers so they can subscribe.

It's as simple as that!
